literal_meaning: কুকুরের লেজের আড়াই পাক (dog's tail curling two and a half times)
figurative_meaning_en: An inherent flaw or unchangeable bad habit in one's nature
similar_in_english: A leopard can't change its spots
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কুকুরের আড়াই পাক স্বভাব, কখনো সৎ হবে না।
এই অভ্যাস তার কুকুরের আড়াই পাক, বদলানো অসম্ভব।
example_sentences_in_english: His dog's two-and-a-half curl nature means he'll never be honest.
This habit is his inherent flaw, impossible to change.
history: Originated from observing the natural curl of a dog's tail, symbolizing traits that cannot be altered, common in rural Bengali oral traditions.
note: The idiom draws from everyday animal behavior in Bengali rural life.
